ops.title: Decision: retire bluebubbles VM via corten-matrix on metal (supersedes Variant F)
ops.body:
2026-07-18: reopened + freshened the retire-the-bluebubbles-VM decision. **PICK = `lrhodin/corten-matrix` (MPL-2.0) run on METAL** — not on hermes, and not the custom BB-REST shim.

**Supersedes Variant F** (the `imsg-bridge` rustpush→BlueBubbles-REST shim; plan acct-09 `revisit-...-dapper-taco.md`, backlog task 8540836b). Variant F now carries a live blocker: macOS 26 Tahoe PAC-protected `identityservicesd`'s `NACKeyEstablishment`/`NACSign` and `mac-registration-provider` is archived (OpenBubbles rustpush issue #21, open) — so building the NAC path ourselves fights Tahoe.

**Why corten wins:**
- Registers via `AAAbsintheContext` (AppleAccount.framework), NOT the PAC-broken path #21 documents; live user registered on macOS 26.5.1 (corten issue #68). Tahoe is not a blocker for corten's path.
- hermes-agent ALREADY ships a native mautrix Matrix adapter (`plugins/platforms/matrix/adapter.py`: typing, read receipts, reactions/tapbacks, threads, E2EE; platforms config-driven, concurrent) → **zero hermes code change**, config swap only.
- MPL-2.0; we run the released binary so no SSPL/rustpush copyleft reaches yclaw.

**Topology (Apple identity never leaves metal; metal never initiates east-west):** iMessage/APNs ⇄ corten-matrix (metal) ⇄[appservice · metal-loopback] Matrix homeserver (metal) ⇄[tailnet · hermes-initiated /sync] hermes-agent matrix bot (hermes). Fleet → one macOS guest (metal) + one Linux guest (hermes); bluebubbles deleted. Reuses the Variant-F metal daemon machinery (launchd/pf/socketfilterfw/imsgstate/host-key harvest).

**Tapbacks = an UPGRADE:** today's BlueBubbles path can only detect+skip inbound tapbacks and CANNOT send them (upstream stub); corten does both directions.

**#1 gate (Phase 0, unproven):** does corten's macOS binary run headless on metal (a VM) using the EXTERNAL host-extracted key (never native VM registration = confirmed ban vector)? Plus a throwaway Apple ID + one-time host key-extraction. Full plan: acct-16 plans `we-were-going-to-tranquil-metcalfe.md`. Relates to [[imessage-protocol-direct-landscape]], [[bluebubbles-server-bringup-2026-07]].
